title: Irish Cheese Fondue
description: A twist on the classic fondue, this Irish cheese fondue combines zesty with a smooth and creamy cheese sauce, perfect for dipping crusty bread.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over low heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Sprinkle the flour over the garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Slowly pour in the white wine, whisking constantly.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, until it thickens.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the zesty Irish cheddar cheese until melted and smooth.
Serve the fondue warm, with crusty bread for dipping.
Transfer the fondue to a small baking dish and bake for 5-7 minutes, until bubbly and golden brown.
